title: ExplosiveWords

# 📖 EWords — How to Use

EWords is a word game mod for Minecraft where players compete in real time by typing words that contain a given syllable, before the timer runs out.

---

## 🎮 Starting a Game

Use the `/ewords` command to start a match:
/ewords <lives> <time> <player1> [player2] ... [player8]

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description | Range |
|-----------|-------------|-------|
| `lives` | Number of lives each player starts with | 1 – 10 |
| `time` | Time limit per turn (in seconds) | 1 – 60 |
| `player1` | First player (required) | — |
| `player2` ... `player8` | Additional players (optional) | — |

> **Minimum:** 2 players are required to start a match.

---

## 📝 Examples

**2 players, 3 lives, 30 seconds per turn:**
/ewords 3 30 Steve Alex

**4 players, 5 lives, 15 seconds per turn:**
/ewords 5 15 Steve Alex Notch Herobrine

**Maximum lobby, 1 life, 10 seconds (high pressure!):**
/ewords 1 10 p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 p7 p8

---

## 🕹️ How to Play

1. When it's your turn, a **syllable** appears on screen.
2. Type a word that **contains that syllable** before the timer runs out.
3. If your word is valid, you keep your lives. If not — or if time runs out — you lose a life.
4. A player is **eliminated** when they run out of lives.
5. The last player standing **wins**.
